STEP 2 — AI MODERATION SCAN (5 parallel models)
─────────────────
1. VISUAL (AWS Rekognition + Google Vision):
   Nudity/explicit: frame-by-frame every 2s
   Violence/gore: blood, weapons, fighting
   Self-harm imagery detection
   Score 0–100 per frame, 95th-percentile used
2. AUDIO NLP (OpenAI Whisper + custom model):
   Transcribes speech (detected language)
   Hate speech / slurs / threats
   Explicit lyrics filter
   Spam/scam phrase patterns
3. COPYRIGHT (AudioFingerprint + MatchEngine):
   Compares audio vs 100M+ licensed tracks
   Detects watermarks (TikTok/IG logos)
   Match → flags 'Possible copyright' + source
4. SPAM/INAUTHENTIC (custom model):
   Duplicate content (hash comparison)
   Repetitive engagement-bait patterns
   Bot-generated captions
5. MISINFORMATION (OpenAI + fact-check APIs):
   Health misinfo flags
   Adds 'May contain unverified claims' label only
─────────────────
RISK SCORE OUTPUT:
  LOW 0–39 → auto-approve → node 1407
  MEDIUM 40–69 → human review → node 1406
  HIGH 70–100 → auto-reject → node 1408
Processing time: 30s–5min (by length)
